title: One Day, One Wild Heart — Nairobi

scenes.narrationKo: Where else do lions greet the sunrise with a city skyline behind them? Only here.
scenes.cardSummary: A dawn safari where wild lions roam minutes from downtown skyscrapers.
scenes.visualPrompt: Dawn golden light. The family of four stands in an open safari jeep, blankets over shoulders, breath visible in cool morning air — the two children <IMAGE_REF_2> <IMAGE_REF_3> point in awed silence at giraffes silhouetted against the sunrise and distant skyline. Guide <IMAGE_REF_4> holds binoculars, whispering. No one speaks loudly; pure wonder. Characters small in frame — let the savanna breathe. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narrationKo: No jeep needed here — just your own two feet, eye to eye with the wild.
scenes.cardSummary: A raised boardwalk trail for meeting Kenya's animals on foot.
scenes.visualPrompt: Morning light on a wooden boardwalk. The youngest child <IMAGE_REF_3> locks eyes with a leopard resting below — both perfectly still, a silent duel of curiosity. The older child <IMAGE_REF_2> holds the rail wide-eyed; parents <IMAGE_REF_0> <IMAGE_REF_1> exchange a smile behind them. Guide <IMAGE_REF_4> crouches to the kids' eye level, pointing gently. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narrationKo: Three million years of family history — come high-five your oldest ancestors.
scenes.cardSummary: Kenya's story of humankind, from first footsteps to today.
scenes.visualPrompt: Museum hall, warm light. The children <IMAGE_REF_2> <IMAGE_REF_3> raise their palms in a playful high-five toward an early-human exhibit display; dad <IMAGE_REF_0> mimics a hominid walking pose, mom <IMAGE_REF_1> laughs into her hand. Guide <IMAGE_REF_4> gestures like a proud professor. Respectful fun, no touching exhibits. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narrationKo: Fair warning: loosen your belt. Here the meat comes to you, and it never stops.
scenes.cardSummary: An endless parade of fire-grilled skewers, served tableside.
scenes.visualPrompt: Lively churrascaria. Three servers circle the family's table with towering meat skewers like an honor guard; the kids <IMAGE_REF_2> <IMAGE_REF_3> hold up their plates with sparkling eyes, dad <IMAGE_REF_0> surrenders his belt buckle comically, mom <IMAGE_REF_1> flips her card to 'more'. Guide <IMAGE_REF_4> nods approval like a general. Steam and sizzle. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narrationKo: Giant babies, giant bottles — watch out, this much cuteness can break a heart.
scenes.cardSummary: An orphanage where baby elephants drink milk and steal hearts.
scenes.visualPrompt: Midday. A baby elephant drinks from a huge milk bottle; the youngest child <IMAGE_REF_3> mirrors it with a water bottle, cheeks puffed. A playful trunk splashes red mud toward dad <IMAGE_REF_0> who takes it heroically; mom <IMAGE_REF_1> and the older child <IMAGE_REF_2> collapse laughing. Guide <IMAGE_REF_4> shields his suit with a tiny leaf, in vain. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narrationKo: That tongue is half your arm long — and yes, it is coming straight for your hand.
scenes.cardSummary: Feed endangered Rothschild giraffes straight from your palm.
scenes.visualPrompt: Afternoon sun. A giraffe lowers its great head over the feeding platform; its long tongue reaches for a pellet on the older child's <IMAGE_REF_2> open palm — the child frozen between terror and delight. The youngest <IMAGE_REF_3> queues next holding a pellet like a medal. Parents <IMAGE_REF_0> <IMAGE_REF_1> film everything, missing their own pellets being stolen by a second giraffe. Guide <IMAGE_REF_4> mediates the heist diplomatically. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narrationKo: A European garden under an African sky — the golden hour everyone came for.
scenes.cardSummary: The storied farmhouse garden glowing at golden hour.
scenes.visualPrompt: Late-afternoon golden hour in a lush colonial garden. The family walks slowly in a loose line along a flower path, long shadows trailing; mom <IMAGE_REF_1> touches a blossom, the kids <IMAGE_REF_2> <IMAGE_REF_3> carry fallen jacaranda petals like treasure. Quiet, painterly, almost still. Guide <IMAGE_REF_4> waits by the path, hat over chest. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narrationKo: When the drums start, sitting still is simply not an option.
scenes.cardSummary: Kenya's traditional dance and drums at full blast.
scenes.visualPrompt: Sunset amphitheater energy. Drummers and dancers mid-performance; the performers wave the family in — the kids <IMAGE_REF_2> <IMAGE_REF_3> leap up copying the dance steps, dad <IMAGE_REF_0> attempts the jump woefully low, mom <IMAGE_REF_1> claps the rhythm. Guide <IMAGE_REF_4> drums on his knees. Firelight warmth, motion everywhere. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narrationKo: No ocean in this city — yet here comes a lobster the size of a club. What a day.
scenes.cardSummary: Nairobi's grand seafood table, famous for colossal lobster.
scenes.visualPrompt: Warm candlelit dining room. A server presents a comically huge lobster platter; the kids' <IMAGE_REF_2> <IMAGE_REF_3> jaws drop in perfect sync. The family raises glasses in a slow toast; through the window, the city lights glow. The youngest <IMAGE_REF_3> is already asleep against mom's <IMAGE_REF_1> arm by dessert, clutching a jacaranda petal from the garden. Guide <IMAGE_REF_4> toasts the camera — a grateful end. Vertical 9:16.
